cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(interlace_whisper LANGUAGES C CXX ASM)

set(CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM 3.5 CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR lib CACHE PATH "" FORCE)

set(WHISPER_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WHISPER_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WHISPER_BUILD_SERVER OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WHISPER_BUILD_IS_DEV OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WHISPER_CURL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WHISPER_SDL2 OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WHISPER_COREML OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WHISPER_OPENVINO OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WHISPER_VITISAI OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

set(GGML_METAL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_METAL_EMBED_LIBRARY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_CUDA OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_VULKAN OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_BLAS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_ACCELERATE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_OPENMP OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_OPENMP_FETCH OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_NATIVE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_RPC OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_BACKEND_DL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_CCACHE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_HIP OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_MUSA OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_SYCL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_OPENCL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_WEBGPU OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

add_subdirectory(whisper.cpp)

add_library(interlace_whisper_shim STATIC shim/transcribe.cpp)
target_include_directories(interlace_whisper_shim PRIVATE
    whisper.cpp/include
    whisper.cpp/ggml/include
)
target_link_libraries(interlace_whisper_shim PUBLIC whisper)

install(TARGETS interlace_whisper_shim whisper ggml ggml-base ggml-cpu
    ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib
    LIBRARY DESTINATION lib
)
